decisive_items: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100
Tumor consisted of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern among large cystic cavities lined by single-layer squamous epithelium
response.rationale: Schwannoma is strongly supported by diffuse S-100 positivity and EMA/pancytokeratin/desmin negativity, with histology showing spindle cells in palisades. Meningioma is contradicted by EMA negativity; hemangioblastoma is contradicted by histology and lacks S-100 pattern.

rejected.why: EMA negativity contradicts meningioma; only location and circumscription are nonspecific.
Histology with squamous-lined cysts and spindle cells is not hemangioblastoma; rim enhancement is nonspecific.
